name: Wildkin Horses Crackerjack Kids' Backpack - Pink
description: Get your little one off to school in style with a Crackerjack Kids' Backpack from Wildkin. This kids backpack is made out of incredibly durable polyester along with being both tear and water resistant. It has tons of pockets for all your child's school accessories - it has a large main zipper pocket, a front zipper accessory pocket, a top loop for hanging on a hook and a mesh side pocket that's perfect for a water bottle. Available in a variety of fun and colorful prints, this kids school backpack also works great for traveling or play date adventures. Color: Pink. Gender: Female. Pattern: Horses.
